name: TecnoNidi Just Transition Fund Taranto
provider: Regione Puglia, managed by Puglia Sviluppo S.p.A. (PN JTF Italia 2021-2027)
summary: Non-repayable and zero-interest support for technology investment plans by small firms with an operational site in the province of Taranto. Applicants must be based in the Taranto province of Puglia.
amount: Investments covered 100%: 40% grant, 40% zero-interest loan, 20% conditional grant; projects EUR 25,000 to 500,000; running costs 90% grant
next_steps: Read the avviso and check the eligible investment list on the official Regione Puglia page
Confirm an operational site in the province of Taranto before applying
Apply online at moduli.regione.puglia.it with SPID, CIE or CNS and submit the form (unsent data is inadmissible)

name: NIDI JTF Taranto (new business incentive)
provider: Regione Puglia, managed by Puglia Sviluppo S.p.A. (JTF Taranto)
summary: Support for new microenterprises in the Taranto area that have not yet formed a company, or are under six months old, where at least half is owned by a listed group such as people aged 18 to 35 or women over 18. Applicants must be based in the Taranto area of Puglia.
amount: Investment EUR 10,000 to 150,000 at 100% aid: 50% grant, 25% repayable loan, 25% repayable assistance; running costs grant up to EUR 15,000
next_steps: Check the category rules (ownership by a listed group) on the official page
Prepare an investment plan of EUR 10,000 to 150,000 for a new business in the Taranto area
Apply online at sistema.puglia.it/nidijtf

name: Sviluppo Tecnologico delle Startup Innovative (FESR)
summary: Non-repayable support for technology development projects by micro or small innovative startups. Applicants must have an operating site in Lombardia, which can be opened by the first payment request.
amount: 80% of eligible costs, up to EUR 1,000,000 (up to EUR 1,500,000 for an operating site in an assisted area)
next_steps: Confirm registration in the special startup innovativa section of the Registro delle Imprese
Prepare the project and its eligible cost plan before 25 Nov 2026 at 15:00 Italian time
Submit through the Bandi e Servizi platform

name: Voucher Startup (Programma Sardegna)
provider: Regione Autonoma della Sardegna, managed by Sardegna Ricerche (PR FESR 2021-2027, Action 1.1.1)
summary: Support for registered innovative startups, founded no more than 48 months earlier and with a working prototype, to develop plans of EUR 40,000 to 200,000. The project must be located in Sardinia.
amount: 70% grant, rising to 85% with premiums (maximum grant EUR 170,000); plans EUR 40,000 to 200,000
next_steps: Confirm registration in the innovative startup register and the 48-month limit
Confirm the project location in Sardinia before applying
Apply online through the SIPES system before 30 Apr 2027 at 12:00 Italian time

name: Nuova Impresa 2026 (Lombardia)
provider: Regione Lombardia, managed by Unioncamere Lombardia
summary: Grant for new micro, small and medium businesses and self-employed workers with a partita IVA who opened a new activity in Lombardy from 1 June 2025 to 31 December 2026. Minimum investment EUR 3,000. Window open until 29 January 2027 or until funds run out.
amount: Up to 50% of eligible costs, maximum EUR 10,000
next_steps: Confirm the activity opened in Lombardy after 1 Jun 2025
Prepare a budget with at least EUR 3,000 of investment
Apply on the Restart platform by Infocamere before the funds run out

name: Voucher Digitalizzazione PMI 2026 (Piemonte)
provider: Regione Piemonte, managed by Unioncamere Piemonte (FESR)
summary: Grant for Piedmont small and medium businesses that adopt at least one listed digital technology such as AI, cloud or robotics. Consulting and training may not exceed 30% of eligible costs. Third edition, EUR 19.2 million.
amount: Grant of 50% to 70% of eligible costs depending on size and project (per the regional notice; check the call text)
next_steps: Check the regional technology list and your company size
Plan a digitalisation project with eligible costs
Apply on the Restart platform between 22 Oct 2026 11:00 and 15 Dec 2026 16:00 Italian time

name: Sostegno allo sviluppo delle startup innovative (Valle d'Aosta)
summary: Grant for micro and small innovative startups in Aosta Valley, founded no more than 5 years ago and operating for at least 6 months, in the regional smart specialisation areas. Plans last 12 to 24 months. Rolling evaluation, open until 30 June 2027 unless extended.
amount: Up to 60% of eligible costs, maximum EUR 150,000
next_steps: Check the startup requirements in article 3 of the notice
Prepare a 12 to 24 month project plan
Apply online on SISPREG2014

name: Bando Neoimpresa (Valle d'Aosta)
summary: Free business plan consulting and a start-up grant for people opening a new business or freelance activity in Aosta Valley, plus specialist support after launch. Open to individuals, including freelancers.
amount: EUR 8,000 for new businesses, EUR 5,000 for new freelance activities, plus EUR 1,000 for women entrepreneurs
next_steps: Read the call and check the application deadline on the page
Apply for the consulting step first
Open the activity and claim the grant within 6 months
